xwikidoc.title: Component Hint Displayer
xwikidoc.content: {{velocity output="false"}} ## Displays a collection property whose value is the hint of a component, e.g. the document store or the chunking ## method. Used as custom displayer through: ## {{include reference="AI.Collections.Code.ComponentHintDisplayer"/}} ## {{velocity}}#_aiLLMComponentHintDisplayer('aiLLM.index.chunkingMethod' $hints 'maxChars'){{/velocity}} ## The hints are the values of the installed components. A stored hint whose component is not installed (any ## more) is shown and kept selected, marked as not installed, so that saving the form never changes it silently. ## The name of a hint is the translation with the key "${translationPrefix}.${hint}.name", or the hint itself. #macro (_aiLLMComponentHintName $translationPrefix $hint $installedHints $return) #set ($aiLLMLocalizationKey = "${translationPrefix}.${hint}.name") #if ($services.localization.get($aiLLMLocalizationKey)) #set ($aiLLMHintName = $services.localization.render($aiLLMLocalizationKey)) #else #set ($aiLLMHintName = $hint) #end #if (!$installedHints.contains($hint)) #set ($aiLLMNotInstalledParameters = [$aiLLMHintName]) #set ($aiLLMNotInstalledKey = 'aiLLM.index.componentNotInstalled') #set ($aiLLMHintName = $services.localization.render($aiLLMNotInstalledKey, $aiLLMNotInstalledParameters)) #end ## #setVariable needs the name of the caller's variable, which "$return" gives only while that variable is null. #set ($return = $NULL) #setVariable("$return" $aiLLMHintName) #end #macro (_aiLLMComponentHintDisplayer $translationPrefix $installedHints $defaultHint) #set ($aiLLMCurrentHint = "$!value") #if ($stringtool.isBlank($aiLLMCurrentHint)) #set ($aiLLMCurrentHint = $defaultHint) #end #if ($type == 'view' || $type == 'search' || $type == 'rendered') #_aiLLMComponentHintName($translationPrefix $aiLLMCurrentHint $installedHints $aiLLMHintLabel) $services.rendering.escape($aiLLMHintLabel, 'xwiki/2.1') #elseif ($type == 'edit') #set ($aiLLMHints = []) #set ($discard = $aiLLMHints.addAll($installedHints)) #if (!$aiLLMHints.contains($aiLLMCurrentHint)) #set ($discard = $aiLLMHints.add($aiLLMCurrentHint)) #end #set ($aiLLMFieldName = "${prefix}${name}") {{html clean="false"}} <select name="$escapetool.xml($aiLLMFieldName)" id="$escapetool.xml($aiLLMFieldName)"> #foreach ($aiLLMHint in $aiLLMHints) #_aiLLMComponentHintName($translationPrefix $aiLLMHint $installedHints $aiLLMHintLabel) #set ($aiLLMSelected = '') #if ($aiLLMHint == $aiLLMCurrentHint) #set ($aiLLMSelected = ' selected="selected"') #end <option value="$escapetool.xml($aiLLMHint)"$aiLLMSelected>$escapetool.xml($aiLLMHintLabel)</option> #end </select> {{/html}} #elseif ($type == 'hidden') {{html clean="false"}} $doc.displayHidden($field, $prefix, $object) {{/html}} #else Unknown display mode. #end #end {{/velocity}}
